edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument into _transfer by transfer().
transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates to the internal _transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender argument when decrementing allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter from flows through the whole _transfer body.
Parameter to flows through the whole _transfer body.
Parameter amount flows through the whole _transfer body.
Local contractTokenBalance is computed and consumed inside _transfer.
Local canSwap gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
Local takeFee selects the taxed or untaxed path in _transfer.
_transfer performs an external swap (swapTokensForEth) before the recipient balances are finalized, leaving an external call inside the transfer flow.
swapTokensForEth invokes the unsafe external router swap that can call back into the token.
block.timestamp is supplied as the router swap deadline.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH lookup and swap target.
The local path array is built and passed to the router in swapTokensForEth.
_transfer forwards the accumulated contract ETH to sendETHToFee.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH payout operation to the fee wallets.
_developmentAddress receives half of the converted ETH.
_marketingAddress receives the other half of the converted ETH.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the dev/marketing addresses.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the dev/marketing addresses.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter exists only as input to _transfer and has no independent semantic identity.
The to parameter exists only as input to _transfer and is absorbed by the transfer logic.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer where limits and fees are applied.
tokenAmount is a straight input to the router swap performed by swapTokensForEth.
amount is only used to compute the two transfers inside sendETHToFee.
recipient is a direct argument of the public transfer function.
amount is a direct argument of the public transfer function.
newOwner is only meaningful as the assignment target of transferOwnership.
notbot is only used to clear one entry of the bots blacklist.
bots_ is consumed entirely by the blockBots loop that writes the blacklist.
accounts is consumed entirely by the fee-exclusion loop.
maxTxAmount exists only to be stored into _maxTxAmount by its setter.
swapTokensAtAmount exists only to update the swap threshold state variable.
contractTokenBalance is a transient helper computed and consumed inside _transfer.
canSwap is a transient boolean deciding the swap branch inside _transfer.
takeFee is a transient boolean used only to route the fee logic in _transfer.
currentRate is a transient reflection rate used by the balance arithmetic in _transferStandard.
path is a transient swap path array built solely for the router call.
